purpose: Track Isla as a daily illustrated diary character; the puzzle is a recurring thread, not her whole life.
known_life_details: She uses puzzles as a small thinking ritual.
She notices light, quiet tables, old buildings, notebooks, mugs, and small transitions between tasks.
Isla uses libraries as reset spaces, not just work spaces.
Isla values ordinary domestic quiet as much as beautiful public spaces.
Bookshops pull Isla into longer pauses than she planned.
Isla sometimes uses a cafe table as a buffer between obligations.
Isla does not mind slower days when they give her room to notice things.
Isla often fits her puzzle ritual between work blocks.
Isla protects small morning rituals when she needs steadiness.
Isla likes journeys because they give her contained thinking time.
